name: Rob Stewart
caption: The fed's play-by-play announcer, a young Chicago-trained broadcaster who favours the babyfaces, modelled on a mid-eighties Tony Schiavone.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Roger Powell
caption: 'The Coach', the color commentator, a curmudgeonly ex-wrestler and Kansas City high-school football coach who favours the heels.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Mark Kincaid
caption: The ring announcer, a tall young man with a booming voice who got his start in Chicago indies.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Alicia Jankowski
caption: The backstage interviewer, a brunette in her mid-twenties with a communications degree and the daughter of a board member.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Jose Ramirez
caption: The roving reporter, an announcer known in Mexico and Texas who will do whatever it takes to get a scoop.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Al Marinaro
caption: The head referee, a bulky former University of Wisconsin football player who was head referee in GLCW.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Carl Jackson
caption: A referee in his early fifties, a retired St. Louis police officer with a quick trigger finger for disqualifications.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Roscoe Murdock
caption: A veteran Memphis referee past sixty, sharp but missing more shenanigans than the others.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Jimmy McDaniel
caption: The youngest and smallest referee, red-haired and easily distracted, used for openers and house shows.

tenures.source: Named in the president's staff list of 23 September 2004.

name: Rampage
caption: A power technician billed from Osaka and living in San Francisco, 5'11" and 255 pounds, dead serious and respected rather than loved; in-fiction real name Takaji Fuyimoto.

tenures.finisher: Rising Sun (figure four crossface); Death Before Dishonor
tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 23 September 2004.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Phoenix
caption: A masked, 29-year-old American trained in Japan, a stiff technician in a black mask with flame wings who is convinced a conspiracy of Illuminati and boards rigs even wrestling; in-fiction real name Joshua Ellike.

tenures.hometown: The Valley of Fire (resides in Villa Park, Illinois)
tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 23 September 2004.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Ben Morst
caption: The slim technical half of Next Revolution, 25, from Casper, Wyoming, who wants respect more than a title.

tenures.finisher: Out of the Frying Pan (hanging armbar)

entrance_music.title: The Photograph is the Proof
entrance_music.verbatim: "The Photograph is the Proof" by Taking Back Sunday

tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 25 September 2004.

name: Jimmy McVee
caption: The 295-pound power wrestler, 24, billed 'Slick', who wants to be the world's greatest but cannot do it without his lifelong friend Ben Morst.

tenures.finisher: Pot, Kettle, Black (northern lights suplex with a bridge)
tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 25 September 2004.

name: Alister Hayze
caption: A small, ripped, free-wheeling Memphis hippie version of Shawn Michaels, born Albert Hinkle, who comes back to the old-school leagues after runs in the FSCW and WWWA and no finisher by design.

tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 28 September 2004.

identity.note: The same distinctive name in the same year: New ERA's Alister Hayze main-events its cards from June 2004 to January 2005, teaming with Jean Rabesque. This profile of 28 September 2004 says he has been 'mostly inactive for the past few years' after runs in the FSCW and WWWA, and neither record names the other's fed. Kept apart on that disagreement until a page ties them; a lead for review, not a ruling that they differ.

name: Mr. Sandman
caption: Reggie Sand, 'The Sandman', a poor New York kid turned underground fighter and marketed boxer, a heel brawler managed by Doc.

tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 29 September 2004.

identity.note: The name or an alias is shared with an existing record on another wing; nothing in either source links the two, so they are kept apart.

name: Heathcliff Mars
caption: A quiet, eccentric dreamer from Greensboro raised on television, obsessed since the 2001 CSWA anniversary show with Eli Flair; a high flyer whose finisher is the Red Five shooting star press.

tenures.source: Profiled in the fed's own forum, 29 September 2004.
